10761.flavor: When I was a child, a Teostra attacked our village. Now, that foul beast has come again to rain destruction down upon us. Please! Put an end to this evil presence!

10762.name: Grim Tidings
10762.flavor: Uh-oh. Our observers over at the Volcano have gone silent. Their last message mentioned something about a "black god." That can't be good. We need someone to investigate.

10763.name: Absolute Zero
10763.flavor: An Ukanlos appeared in the Polar Field and is headed towards this village. But we've got one hope, and that's you. Everyone here believes in you. Please, save our village!

10764.name: The Looming Calamity
10764.flavor: We have met many times, and you have never failed to impress me with your courage in the face of adversity. Now, with Amatsu threatening our village, we need your bravery more than ever.

10765.name: The Brilliant Darkness
10765.flavor: "None can foresee disaster. In darkness, it comes; among despair, it departs. Now is such a time, when all may struggle...and in the end, perish." Catchy, eh? My aide wrote it. Anyway, save us!

10768.name: Legendary Skills?
10768.flavor: Are you ready to prove yourself to me, darling? A Diablos is attacking the neighboring settlements from its lair in the Dunes. Beware its two-horned charge, and watch for when it bursts from the ground too. It knows no mercy!

10770.name: Steppe in the Right Direction
10770.flavor: On my travels across the Ancestral Steppe, I stumbled upon a fearsome Deviljho! I ran as fast as I could, but now my legs have given out. I entrust this message to a Kelbi I befriended on the way -- even though it didn't seem too keen on the idea at first!

10771.name: Rajang's Black Spirit
10771.flavor: It was all so sudden. It just came rushing out of the undergrowth. Mane flowing, wrapped in some dark aura... Wouldn't want to head back in there for fear of meeting that again. We'll have to wait for the Guild to take care of it.

10772.name: Following the Fallen
10772.sub_goal: Wound Silver Rathalos's head and wings
10772.flavor: I first met my husband in the Jurassic Frontier when he rescued me from a Silver Rathalos. So if I can find a Rathalos, maybe I could meet him again... If anyone reads this, please don't come looking for me. I won't give up on him. I can't...

10773.name: Fool's Gold
10773.sub_goal: Wound Gold Rathian's head and wings
10773.flavor: Urgently requesting help in Misty Peaks. Reports of rare Rathian breed attacking patrols from nearby villages. Hunters gone to help now missing. Bad situation we're in. Send help to deal with Rathian!

10774.name: Shining Examples
10774.goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
10774.flavor: A Gold Rathian and a Silver Rathalos... How fierce, how exciting, how beautiful! I can't take my eyes off them... And what better chance to see them again than in the Arena! Don't be shy, get in there!

11101.name: Harvest Tour: Ruined Pinnacle
11101.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11101.flavor: Oh, hello, darling. My intuition tells me that you'd love to go gathering up at the Ruined Pinnacle. Am I wrong? Well, I have just the Quest for you. Go and satisfy your gathering urges, and just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're done. It's as easy as that.

11102.name: Harvest Tour: Desert
11102.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11102.flavor: Hello, darling. I can sense that you're yearning for a taste of the Desert's rich bounty. Don't try and hide it! Go, take this Quest, and scratch that itch. Deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're satisfied. That's all.

11103.name: A Brush with Bugs
11103.flavor: Waaa! I can't... Eww! I need a shower... I was at the Jurassic Frontier, and this absolutely enormous vile insect came flying at me! And then another one, even worse, to top it off! Get out there and squish them! Please! Oh no, is one of them on me!?

11104.name: Riverside Rumble
11104.flavor: Hey, have you got a sec? I wanted to check out the fish from that pretty river they've got in Yukumo, but there was one of those Arzuros things going wild at the Misty Peaks. I can't concentrate on fish with one of those things about. Can you go and whack it for me?

11105.name: Survival of the Biggest
11105.goal: Hunt a Giadrome and a Bulldrome
11105.flavor: A Giadrome and Bulldrome have turned up at the Arctic Ridge and they're beefing over territory. It's getting in the way of my observation activities, so do you think you could snuff them out for me? But be careful... They're pretty beastly.

11106.name: Pecking Order
11106.flavor: Oh, geez, this is really... I mean, this bird thing was just poking at me with its beak... It didn't really hurt, but it was just like... I can't really describe it. I think it would be best all round if you just went and got rid of it for me.

11107.name: Enough Monkeying Around
11107.flavor: Well I never! That vile primate thing came at me in the Primal Forest. I've had it up here with its pranks and tomfoolery! Hunter, could you please take care of it before I do something I regret?

11108.name: The Killer Rabbit of Arctic Ridge
11108.flavor: Don't tell my brother, but I snuck up the mountain to see the bunny. It looked so darn...ANGRY! All my hopes and dreams, dashed in an instant! Where is my cute fluffybun!? Put that abomination somewhere I can't see it, ever!

11109.name: Lost, But Not for Long
11109.flavor: Waaaah! This is just *sob* terrible! My *sniff* my super important survey report... I was out on the Ancestral Steppe when this *hic* Gypceros stole it! My academic career will be OVER!!! You gotta get my report back, *sob* pleeeease!

11110.name: Pleasantly Sozzled
11110.flavor: I've obtained infurmation through completely lawful means on some ingredients in the Jurassic Furrontier which I need for my plan. Unfurtunately a Tetsucabra is in the way... Could you lend me a paw by hunting the monster while I swipe the goods? Nya!

11111.name: Surprise!
11111.goal: Hunt a Cephadrome and a Daimyo Hermitaur
11111.flavor: Okay, just breathe, just breathe... Is this place trying to kill me!? I'm just out traipsing through the sand when a Cephadrome AND Daimyo Hermitaur pop out! I'm not sure how much more I can take... Hunter, can you sort this out before I have an arrest?

11112.name: A Berry Dubious Idea
11112.flavor: Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with the Tropical Berries that grow in the Desert? I just came up with a way to make them really tasty! They're going to be HUGE! I think I smell money... I'll split the profits with you if you collect some for me. 70-30?

11113.name: Daimyo Hermitaur Flambé
11113.flavor: I am determined to teach ma langue divine to tolerate ze heat! Zere is but one purroblème. Fur ze heat, I must be in ze Desert. But in ze Desert, zere are ze meownsters... I love ze crab cakes, but zis Daimyo Hermitaur is too much for me to handle...!

11114.name: Ruined Pinnacle, RUINED
11114.flavor: Th-This is terrible! Because of the intense methane buildup from all the Congas, the Ruined Pinnacle stinks! They just won't stop farting! How are we supposed to do any research under these conditions!? Can you thin their numbers a bit? ...Puaah!

11116.name: Sweetheart's Pick: Lofty Ludroth
11116.flavor: Thanks for accepting this Quest, Hunter! This time you'll be fighting a Royal Ludroth at the Ruined Pinnacle. It's a bit similar to the crazy one my apprentice, the Yukumo Gal, was thinking of. Just, you know, made a bit more sane. I really appreciate your help!

11117.name: Harvest Tour: Ancestral Steppe
11117.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11117.flavor: Interested in gathering at the Ruined Pinnacle, are we? I know just the Quest. Gather away, darling, gather away. Just remember to be a dear and deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.

11118.name: Harvest Tour: Primal Forest
11118.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11118.flavor: So you're looking to gather at the Primal Forest, are you? This Quest should be perfect for you, then, darling. Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done and we'll gladly pick you up.

11119.name: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
11119.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11119.flavor: Gathering in the Jurassic Frontier certainly has its appeal. I'll pull up a Quest for you. Don't be out too late, though, darling -- you'll need to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.

11120.name: Harvest Tour: Dunes
11120.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11120.flavor: The Dunes hold all sorts of curiosities, don't they? Well now, I've got just the Quest to sate your foraging appetite. We will, of course, pick you up as soon as you deliver your Paw Pass Ticket.

11121.name: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
11121.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11121.flavor: Gathering in the Verdant Hills? That brings back memories... Let me fetch a Quest for you, darling. Enjoy your gathering, and remember to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.

11122.name: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
11122.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11122.flavor: Gathering at the Arctic Ridge, are we? Well, I hope you'll wrap up warm. Here's your Quest. Enjoy! Oh, and let me remind you that we'll come and pick you up when you deliver your Paw Pass Ticket.

11123.name: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
11123.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11123.flavor: The Misty Peaks? Gorgeous place for gathering. I'll find a Quest for you right away, darling. You go ahead and enjoy yourself. Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come home.

11124.name: After That Bird!
11124.flavor: A precious Felyne friend with whom I am extremely close, has today become the victim of a wicked Gypceros! It pilfered such a precious gift; it's given him such grief! But now all that is going to change -- Hunter, go smite that thief!

11125.name: Fangs for the Bath
11125.flavor: Mrowwwww! The worst has happened! Two infurnal Arzuros at the Ruined Pinnacle in a furrenzy! We hid in a cave but we got soaked to the skin! We look like something the cat dragged in! Someone, blow them out of the water!

11126.name: Just Five Morel Minutes...
11126.flavor: We're doing some pretty important research here! Namely, how to shed the human need for sleep using the power of mushrooms! So we need some Tall Mushrooms from the Ruined Pinnacle. Wake us when you're back. We're just resting our eyes.

11127.name: Face Two Face
11127.flavor: What a conundrum! I was minding my own business on the Ancestral Steppe when I spotted two monsters with the exact same face! This must be some Kecha Wacha voodoo -- I'm sure of it!

11128.name: Antony and Tetsucabra
11128.flavor: O Hunter, keen of brain and stout of heart; Frontiers Jurassic shall not throw your search, Nor leaping beasties dash you on the rocks (Though lesser hunters, mewling, would flee home.) But catch this toxic monster, let me see; How hunting frogs may yet the hunted be.

11129.name: The Bird Who Wood Be King
11129.flavor: ...Well, I'm in a pickle and no mistake. Went down to the Verdant Hills to gather wood, and got myself chased off by a Yian Kut-Ku. If I can't get wood, then I can't keep a roof over my head. Can somebody fix this birdbrain's wagon for me?

11130.name: Water Fight
11130.flavor: Oh my gosh, two Royal Ludroth have been seen in the Misty Peaks! I have never ever seen two of them in the same place before. EVER! They're so territorial...this can't end well! Get in there and put them down before all hell breaks loose!

11201.name: Harvest Tour: Jungle
11201.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11201.flavor: Ah, hello, darling. If you're interested in gathering in the Jungle, I have a Quest that you simply must try. Just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you've had enough and want out. Bye for now!

11202.name: I See It Rollin'...
11202.flavor: That stupid overgrown fanged tumbleweed! This dumb Volvidon just won't stop trundling around after me. If only there was some brave, strong hunter who could teach it a lesson once and for all... Oh...? You'll take care of it? Seriously? How sweet!

11203.name: Not Mushroom to Swing a Congalala
11203.flavor: You can get real good mushrooms in the Jungle. But lately, them Conga- whatsits have been hogging all the good ones. And that's not the half of it. The Congadoodahs stink so much that you can barely sniff out the mushrooms! You know what to do.

11204.name: Dirty Deals
11204.flavor: Here's a job from one of my regulars. Apparently a Barroth is causing a ruckus in the Desert, and the trade routes are in complete disarray. Go get that muddy scoundrel, and watch out, okay? They move a lot quicker than you'd expect!

11205.name: That's No Rock...
11205.flavor: The rock! It was m-m-moving! It was alive, I swear! I've never seen anything so uncanny... I'll never forget it, ever, but maybe if you get rid of whatever's behind the mystery, I'll find a way to live with the trauma...

11206.name: Treasure Pinnacle: Rice
11206.flavor: I can tell you got the treasure trembles! And yer want a bit of my extra-good Chomoran Rice, don't yer? No? Well, then don't go up to the Ruined Pinnacle and hunt a Malfestio. Simple enough. Don't do it if you don't want it, but don't not do it if you do want it.

11207.name: Through Thick and Fin
11207.flavor: I heard about some of the life habits of Zamtrios and thought "Eureka! This is perfect for the Hunter Art I'm working on!" And it is! And you'll see too, because you're going to hunt it for me in the Frozen Seaway! Give me the details when you return.

11208.name: Chilled to the Marrow
11208.flavor: We're hoping to give our footbath a boost with an extra special, zippy zappy electric bath! Purrovided we can come up with the right meowterials. Want to help? Then we'll need you to hunt a Khezu at the Arctic Ridge. Nothing has as much zap!

11209.name: Feeding Time
11209.flavor: I went to feed the Nerscylla, and it started getting a bit bitey. I made haste, but unfortunately, I dropped my notes. Could you take care of the beast so I can retrieve them? Just remember, it's more scared of you than you are of it.

11210.name: Sky Tribe: Savior of the Skyway
11210.flavor: Oh, Hunter, we're in trouble! A big dumb Rathian has staked out its territory right in the path of the Soaratorium. Can you go to the Jungle and fix it so it, uh, doesn't have any more birthdays?

11211.name: Share the Load (and the Reward)
11211.flavor: You gotta help me with a Quest the Master of Style gave me! What I need you to do is hunt a Nibelsnarf in the Desert, while I take care of the other monster! This is gonna be Radalos!

11212.name: Shadows in the Desert Lake
11212.flavor: I was fishing in the Desert, like you do, when I caught a Plesioth. Wouldn't you know it, he wasn't too pleased? Now he's gone a little bit crazy and our caravan's in a tizzy. Any more of this and we won't have anywhere to go back to. Can you help out?

11213.name: Earn Your Strength
11213.flavor: If you want more power...you have to prove...prove that you're strong enough... Blangonga...in the Arctic Ridge... If you're not strong enough... you'll fail.

11214.name: Feeling Generally Crabby
11214.flavor: AAAARGH! DAMN IT!!! I was all ready to get back to questing, but my guts are STILL acting up. I better pass this one on to you, Scrawn. Gotta hunt a Shogun Ceanataur in the Volcano. Even you can manage that, right? HAHAHA!

11215.name: A Coil to Arms
11215.flavor: You know, you shouldn't laugh when a girl tells you embarrassing yet formative traumas, like getting a monster wedgie! DON'T LAUGH! ...Um, maybe I just shouldn't have told you. Oh, and your mark is in the Verdant Hills.

11216.name: Face-off in the Jungle
11216.flavor: This time we'd like you to hunt a Nargacuga in the Jungle. You should be able to pick up a few things you'll need for some new Hunter Arts, but we'll save that for when you come back victorious. Just keep an open mind and you'll learn a lot.

11217.name: Poisoned Primal Forest
11217.flavor: Oh dear... A pack a Ioprey in the Primal Forest is getting poison everywhere, and villagers could be in danger. We wanted to take care of this ourselves, but at this rate, we'll even have to start asking Felynes for help. Oh, is there nobody capable of doing this Quest?

11218.name: Hit the Lights
11218.flavor: My eyes! My eyeeees! Those blasted Great Thunderbugs are so bright, I think they've blinded me! There's a great swarm of them here in the Jungle. Please, make them go away before they leave me with permanent retinal damage!

11219.name: Shelling Out for Fashion
11219.flavor: Shell-based accessories are, like, the trendiest things right now in the city. I'm an urban gal at heart, so this is pretty much a life and death matter for me! So, uh, can you get me the materials I need from the Jungle?

11220.name: Harvest Tour: Frozen Seaway
11220.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11220.flavor: I can see you're determined to go gathering at the Frozen Seaway. Well, watch you don't catch a death of cold, darling! I'll let you go, but only if you promise me to deliver your Paw Pass Ticket when you're finished.

11221.name: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
11221.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11221.flavor: So you'd like to do some gathering on the Deserted Island, would you? Let me just get your Quest ready. When you find enough things worth your while, just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket and we'll gladly pick you up.

11222.name: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
11222.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11222.flavor: Gathering in the Marshlands? Well, watch where you step, darling. All right, I've got your Quest here. Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket whenever you feel you're done and we'll pick you up.

11223.name: Harvest Tour: Volcano
11223.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11223.flavor: Gathering at the Volcano, are we? I'll give you the Quest, darling, but you're not to stay in there too long. We've had enough hunters coming back with heat stroke already. Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket as soon as you're done, do you hear?

11224.name: The Legend of King Apple
11224.flavor: Ever since I heard about 'em, I've been questin' my butt off lookin' for those legendary apples. And now, at last, I found 'em! Hangin' from some trees at the Ruined Pinnacle. All I need now is for you to shift the darn Volvidon blockin' 'em!

11225.name: Smithy Business
11225.flavor: Every waking moment I spend working on equipment, forging slowly ahead. Every day, it's head down, nose to the grindstone, hammering away. The anvil is my life. I've no time to be fetching Comet Rocks from the Ruined Pinnacle! You can do that!

11226.name: Royal Assassination
11226.flavor: What are we travelers to do now that a Rathian's taken up occupancy at the Ancestral Steppe? Health and Safety are sure to have something to say about this! Unless of course, you'd like to deal with the matter?

11227.name: Zamite Fright
11227.flavor: So there I was, mining away at the Frozen Seaway, when suddenly I felt something sharp stick me from behind. I tell you, when I saw those odd spiky beasts, I ran like the wind! Even now, I walk around covering my backside... Those Zamites have to go!

11228.name: Fishing's Lure
11228.flavor: Nothin' beats fishing. It's just like being a kid again! You should take a load off and catch some Goldenfish. You'll find a glimmer of the good ol' days in the glitter of water in the Frozen Seaway!

11229.name: The Next Stage of E-Volvi-lution
11229.goal: Hunt a Volvidon and a Great Maccao
11229.flavor: On my way home from the Jurassic Frontier I was spotted by a Volvidon and a Great Maccao! Luckily I threw myself into a series of somersaults and I think they've accepted me as one of them. I think they like me! Unfortunately I'm super dizzy already, so help...?

11230.name: Brute of the Sands
11230.flavor: There's something mighty abnormal out there in the Dunes. It's so tough it can't be hurt with normal weapons, and covers itself in mud. It's all very fascinating! There's still so much we don't know about this majestic creature. Could you catch me one?

11231.name: Trade Dispute
11231.flavor: Our usual trade route is being terrorized by a Nibelsnarf! We'd just tough it out, but Nibelsnarfs will eat anything, and I can't afford to lose another shipment! Please teach the brute it's not okay to steal! Theft isn't a victimless crime!

11232.name: We've Reached Peak Blangonga
11232.flavor: I saw...ulp...a Blangonga on the mountain. Not so weird, you might think. But when...urk...I saw the second one emerge from the ground, I high-tailed it to a cave. This is altogether too many Blangongas for one person to deal with! Please...ulp...deal with it for me!

11233.name: Please Plesioth Me!
11233.flavor: Everyone in Cheeko Sands is in trouble! A Plesioth has made an appurrance and is furolicking very destructively! It's rampaging around the Misty Peaks, and the people of Cheeko Sands asked if you'd purrlease hunt it.

11234.name: Jumping at Shadows
11234.flavor: Oh my gosh! I totally just saw a huge black shadow jump into a tree! I think it's going to attack the village! Arghhh! The problem is, no one believes me! You have to help my village! And then tell them I was right and they should take me more seriously in future!!!

11235.name: The Owled Man and the Sea
11235.flavor: Welp, I guess this old-timer's plumb out of luck. Thought it'd be nice to retire in the sun on the Deserted Island, but the place has a Malfestio problem and it's got its owl dust all over everything. Oh, don't worry about me, I'm just old and useless. I'm sure I'll be fine. I'll manage.

11236.name: The Shadow in the Cave
11236.flavor: We were doing some research in the caves when all of a sudden, something really creepy and gross plopped down behind us. We managed to escape, but we can't do any research with that thing up there!

11237.name: March Melancolico
11237.flavor: The stage: the darkest marshlands, damp with haunting melancholy! Our villain: the ultimate Najarala! Our hero: a hunter of legend! ...That would be you. Go earn us a standing ovation! Break a leg!

11238.name: Interruption: Conga Line
11238.flavor: Give me strength! If there's a village where they sell a cure for idiocy, please tell me where it is. What kind of Guild Gal runs off to take on a couple of Congalalas? Please make sure you get to them first.

11239.name: Commission: Basarios
11239.flavor: Hey, so I just got a request to hunt down a Basarios, but I'm incredibly busy doing an important, uh, other thing. I'd be very grateful if you could take it on for me. I'd hurry if I was you, or you might not make it to the Volcano in time!

11240.name: Great Ore Discovery
11240.flavor: Great news! A new Coal bed has been discovered in the Volcano, and as much as I'd like to get in on that action, the place is Basarios turf. Care to go mining for me, Hunter?

11241.name: Minion's Devotion
11241.flavor: Recently, minion's sense of duty has been lacka-wacking! Cha-Cha has prepared Quest to solidify minion's devotion! Go bash many monster in aka-arena! If minion not up to challenge, come tell Cha-Cha, okay?

11242.name: So Notable: Hyper Hermitaur
11242.flavor: The next page of my notebook is whispering to me, Squiggle. And do you know what it's saying? It's saying HYPER MONSTERS! So, I figure I should give it what it wants! Could you hunt down a Daimyo Hermitaur while I watch from a safe distance?

11243.name: Revenge from the Skies
11243.flavor: Oh, that Yian Kut-Ku had such an aura... I've never seen the likes of it before! I'll bet it was some kind of spectral manifestation of the unquiet spirits of its hunted brethren! What's certain is it was totally consumed by rage! Be careful when you hunt it!

11244.name: Commission: Hyper Kecha Wacha
11244.sub_goal: Wound Kecha Wacha's ears and tail
11244.flavor: There's so much to learn from those so-called "Hyper" monsters, but there's nobody I trust to bring back the kind of data I'm interested in...except you, hunter. Could you go to the Ancestral Steppe and hunt down a Hyper Kecha Wacha for me, please?

11245.name: Frog's Face, Demon's Heart
11245.flavor: The mug on that Tetsucabra is as scary as any demon. How can I put the nature of its fierce, defiant aura into words...? Anyway, I've got the feeling that it's going to take a hard-bitten Hunter like you to have that beast on the boat to Hades.

11246.name: The Hype is Royal
11246.sub_goal: Wound Royal Ludroth's head and mane
11246.flavor: I'm researching Hyperosity in monsters, and my experiments call for a Royal Ludroth. Aren't you the least bit interested to know how one would look all Hypered up? Sure you are! Go find me one of those babies and let's find out! For science!

11247.name: The Verdant Hills Are Alive
11247.flavor: I'm sort of concerned about this Hyper Gypceros running wild over the Verdant Hills... It's pretty inconvenient, and the monster just seems happy as a pig in mud. It's really raising my stress levels, so do you think you could maybe convince it to behave? Or just hunt it?

11248.name: Queen of the Ruined Pinnacle
11248.flavor: I got lost, and after wandering for ages I found myself in a strange fantasy land. Or so I thought. Actually, it was the Ruined Pinnacle, and I'd stumbled into Rathian territory. Me and another lost traveler are hiding from it now. Help!

11249.name: Afro Soul Is a Way of Life
11249.flavor: Oh baby! If you want to truly funk up your soul, there's only one place to go: the Volcano! Hot hot HOT, baby! You got this! You're gonna dip your soul in some o' that Lavasioth magic, baby!

11250.name: Naked Aggression
11250.flavor: There was a hunter in town walking about in only his drawers! Naturally I had to protect the townspeople, so I questioned him. He claims a Ceanataur ripped up his clothes! I need you to verify his claims, and eliminate the monster. If there is one.

11302.name: The Unapproachable Yian Garuga
11302.flavor: Please, Hunter, I need you to hunt a Yian Garuga! It's been on the most wanted list for so long now, I've lost count of how many other hunters it's taken down! I think its nest is in the Ruined Pinnacle. Go give that big chicken a real good basting!

11303.name: Uragaan Grief
11303.flavor: I got sent to the Volcano on a meownster-hunting expedition but a big, furrocious Uragaan purrevented us from going any further! I can see it even meow, looming befur me... Purrlease, Hunter, meowst it from that place!

11304.name: The Lost Expedition
11304.flavor: I'm worried, Hunter. We haven't heard a peep from one of our Frozen Seaway-expedition teams. Mind investigating? It's a cold, cruel region, so gird those loins before you go! Pave the way for our exploration.

11305.name: The Royal Guard
11305.flavor: A Seltas Queen is nesting in the Jurassic Frontier! Rumor has it "her majesty" relies on a soldier-like male of the species for protection. I could write a book about their relationship. Help me!

11306.name: Predator in the Hills
11306.goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
11306.flavor: I was herding a flock of Moofahs in the Verdant Hills, when suddenly along came a Rathian and a Rathalos! I hid the moment I saw them, but I was too scared to move, and so were my babies! Please, save us before we end up on their plate!

11307.name: The Sun, Also Wyverns
11307.flavor: Welp, looks like this old-timer's outta luck again. It's such a nice day, I thought I'd go for a dip in the sea, but a Lagiacrus popped up and shocked me. No, save your concern. I'll just lie here and not move until I die and stop being such a hindrance to you young folk.

11308.name: Return from the Pinnacle
11308.flavor: We came to survey the Ruined Pinnacle, but had a run-in with a very tetchy Zinogre. We tried to evacuate all the researchers, but the unfamiliar terrain is really making that difficult. Could you remove the Zinogre, please?

11309.name: A Certain Gravitas
11309.flavor: Ah, Volcanic Hollow, bereft of life, where not a blade of grass grows nor cheerful swallow sings. The only thing that stirs is the bubbling magma... and the furiously rampaging Gravios, of course. Actually, you should probably do something about that.

11310.name: Water Kerfuffle
11310.flavor: My meowster, ever the romeowntic, said he met the meowst wonderful lady in a dream. He said something about her "wondrous bubbles" and "lustrous pink crest"... Oh my stripes and whiskers, he's fallen in love with a Mizutsune, hasn't he? Help!

11311.name: Pinnacle Pioneering
11311.flavor: Howdy, everybody! The King requested a thorough cataloging of the Ruined Pinnacle. Just when I was thinking how completely normal and uninteresting it was, POW! SHAZAM! You're up, Hunter!

11312.name: Ice Recovery
11312.flavor: Let me tell you about the most amazing thing the Frozen Seaway has to offer. Imagine: ice from Gammoth snowballs that's been trampled down to become part of the ground. Ugh, so post-modern! I must have some! Will you help me?

11313.name: The Boiling Broiling Desert
11313.flavor: Blazing sun! Earth dry as a bone! And to top it off, the flaming breath of a Glavenus! It's too hot to stand! Unless someone does something about that beast, I won't make it out of this desert. How about you, Hunter? Or is the challenge too hot to handle?

11314.name: Eclipse at Jurassic Frontier
11314.flavor: Boy, has my luck run out today. I was fleeing through the Jurassic Frontier when I tripped and fell. I cried out in pain, and a disgusting black creature sidled up to me. This is it, I'm done for. Heavens help me! I promise I'll change my ways!

11316.name: A Pinnacle Just for You
11316.flavor: My acquaintance says hunters love to pursue their prey as long as they've got the stamina to do so. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. Would you mind popping up to the Ruined Pinnacle to demonstrate for me?

11317.name: The Phantom Beast!
11317.flavor: That thing we spotted up on the Arctic Ridge must have been the Phantom Beast. It radiated a faint light as it slid along the ground. Whoever hunts it down is in for some pretty sweet loot, that's for sure!

11318.name: Reality or Fantasy?
11318.flavor: Ugh... The Jurassic Frontier... Yes, that's where the horned phantom showed itself... And unless that white beast's fury is stopped, the land will be plunged into disaster! Hunters of the Oracle, hear me! Defeat the Phantom Beast and fulfill the prophecy!

11319.name: Giant Dragon Invasion
11319.goal: Slay a Lao-Shan Lung or repel it
11319.flavor: An urgent report from the Schrade region came in. A Lao-Shan Lung has been attacking settlements there. I'd like you to help defend a fort on one of its regular attack paths. Pay attention to barricade integrity, and of course, keep an eye on the monster!

11325.name: Trial by Fart
11325.flavor: So, not to brag or anything but I'm a pretty big deal in my hunter class. They expect great things of me. So I thought I'd go prove them all right by hunting something awesome! Uh, I didn't realize Congalala are so hard to hunt though. Can you come save my reputation?

11327.name: The Mud Must Flow
11327.flavor: Here's a tip: the most amazing thing from the Dunes is obviously the mud a Barroth flings off itself, once it's all dried in the sun! Ugh, just talking about it makes me want some. Hey, can you help me snag some?

11328.name: The Pinnacle of Good Records
11328.flavor: Howdy everybody! Out on the road I saw huge boulders cracking together and something came lumbering out! It gave off a sort of black aura, and I thought, well darn, this is gonna make for one heck of a record! You wanna get over here and help me record it?

11329.name: Sweets for My Sweets
11329.flavor: I wanna repay everyone who helped advertise my business by making a super awesome dessert! All the secret ingredients I need are in the Jurassic Frontier, but what is also there is a Malfestio! Eek! Hunty, pleeease help get rid of it? I'll give you cake? Please?

11330.name: Zamtrios, Right Ahead!
11330.flavor: It's unsinkable, they said. Enjoy the maiden voyage of this decadent ship, they said. It definitely won't be split in half by a marauding sharkbeast, they said. Look, can someone hunt this thing? The carpets are getting ruined in first class. I can't even look at steerage.

11331.name: Frozen Seaway Horror Story
11331.flavor: I was crawling around a cave on the Frozen Seaway, looking for something, as one does, when I became aware of a presence. A white face floated in the dark behind me. A jagged mouth...a long...long...neck... -- Here the record ends --

11332.name: Temnoceranophobia
11332.flavor: My master is an awesome hunter... most of the time. One day he just blurted out that he can't deal with "creepy Nerscylla" -- something about their eyes? -- and now he's just not the same to me. Can you wipe this stain from his honor by taking over the hunt?

11333.name: The Pinnacle of Terror
11333.flavor: I'm spending time in the company of some Lynians at the Ruined Pinnacle. See, they took me in when I was chased by a Hyper Rathian. I'm a live and let live kind of hunter, but these Lynians might still be in danger. Can you take out the Rathian? I'll just chill here.

11334.name: Eat in Pieces
11334.flavor: I have this kind of embarrassing habit whenever I eat, so I thought what better place to eat in privacy than the Desert, right? WRONG. I nearly turned into dinner when this Nibelsnarf with a seriously dark aura turned up! I just want to eat in peace!

11335.name: Diabolical Deluge
11335.flavor: The worst has happened. A Hyper Plesioth arrived in the Jungle and has flooded the river. Six villages are underwater! Communication is cut off due to the damage. We need an outstanding hunter to get in there and sort this mess out!

11336.name: Shhhhut Up
11336.flavor: *psst* We had some heavy snow, now everyone is terrified there'll be an avalanche. We have to be super quiet! Even this writing is in a whisper. We can hold out, but there's a Hyper Blangonga nearby who could ruin everything! Could you maybe shut it up?

11337.name: It's a Miner's Life
11337.flavor: 'Ey up. Been trouble down t'mine. No sooner did we start work than a bleedin' great Lavasioth turned up! We miners're no stranger to danger, but we're not idiots. If you could duff it up or summit so we can get back to work, that'd be grand. Ta!

11338.name: No Place to Run
11338.flavor: I was walking down the safest road I know to get back home, nothing bad's ever happened on this road and you know where I'm going with this, don't you? Hyper Shogun Ceanataur. You gotta get rid of it or I'll never get back to my village. Please help!

11339.name: ...Or Just Wait for It to Poop
11339.flavor: What I'm about to tell you is absolutely true, I swear. It sounds crazy, but my armor-crafting friend made a suit of hermetically sealed armor and...well, got swallowed whole by a Hyper Najarala. Please do something, Hunter!

11340.name: Nargacuga in the Jurassic Frontier
11340.flavor: The Jurassic Frontier. All is shrouded in darkness. Suddenly, crimson splits the gloom on wings of shadow! The fearsome Nargacuga stands, wrapped in fog and illuminated by a single shaft of moonlight... Then you come out of nowhere and beat it up. Okay?

11343.name: Harvest Tour: Volcanic Hollow
11343.goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11343.flavor: Ah, gathering time again? Then I've got just the Quest for you, darling. Gathering up as much as you can, and deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you've had enough.

11344.name: Paralyzing Peril
11344.flavor: I came here with my meowster, but as we were exploring I felt a tingle in my meowstache. Then we were attacked by the tingle king himself, Lagiacrus! We got purralyzed before we could blink! Purrlease help!

11345.name: Problem at the Pinnacle
11345.flavor: The Ruined Pinnacle hides so many secrets, but my efforts to uncover them have been met by more than a little resistance from the resident Gore Magala. Any chance you could, you know...make it go away?

11346.name: Strutting the Royal Runway
11346.flavor: The spotlight beckons! For my next performance, I am to dance gracefully upon the shell of a Neopteron. Our props team is too stingy to make one, so fetch me the real thing instead. Break a leg!

11347.name: Hunt-a-Thon: Yian Garuga
11347.flavor: A pair of Yian Garuga have reared their ugly heads, and it seems the Jungle isn't big enough for both of them. They're just screaming their heads off and smashing things up! Hunter, please put a stop to their pathetic squabble!

11348.name: Primal Forest Fears
11348.goal: Hunt a Nerscylla and a Malfestio
11348.flavor: While traversing the Primal Forest, I've realized something very strange. I should have been going east this whole time, but I've clearly gone west. I...I can't move my feet! Oh no...no, it can't be... It's a-- -- Here the record ends --

11349.name: Hunt-a-Thon: Gravios
11349.goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
11349.flavor: An' ole pal o' mine asked if this here Caravaneer could take a gander at some Gravios a-nestin' in the Primal Forest. Normally I'd be happy to oblige the feller, but I can't handle 'em on my ownsome. Can ya handle maybe two of 'em?

11350.name: Hunter Dojo: Tail-do
11350.flavor: You seek the way of the hunter, do you? Then you must hone your abilities! Your mind must be as sharp as the tail of Glavenus-sensei! And when we are finished, you will have a smoldering battle instinct to rival the beast itself!

11351.name: It's Gotta Be Coal
11351.flavor: Do they expect me to work my culinary magic using a wood fire, like some kind of common COOK? I am a chef! I require Coal! You! Fetch me some from the Volcanic Hollow. You should really know how to make a pickaxe by now -- Mystery Bone and Iron Ore, remember?

11352.name: PR Disaster
11352.goal: Hunt a Rathian and a Glavenus
11352.flavor: There's been sightings of a serious threat to Bherna's tourist industry! And people, I guess. We've got a Glavenus on the ground and a Rathian in the sky... We're basically inaccessible as it stands! Please, do something! Our PR hangs in the balance!

11353.name: I Hope It's Not Barioth Flavored
11353.flavor: Discovery of the century! A machine that CREATES SORBET! I'll call it... "Sorby McSorbface". Or something. I can decide on a name after you get back from Barioth hunting. Oh, did I forget to mention that? I need you to go hunt a Barioth. Snap to it!

11354.name: Hunter Dojo: Tusk-fu
11354.flavor: Push, shove, heave, and then some! To join our dojo, you must first capture Gammoth-sensei! There are no clever tricks. You must become one with the mountain. Firm! Strong! Resolute! And being really darn stubborn can't hurt either!

11355.name: Howl at the Moon
11355.flavor: I'm trying to remember something I saw in a dream long ago... You know what might help me recall it, Hunter? If you could purrchance go to the Misty Peaks and hunt a Zinogre. That news is sure to jog my memory, nya!

11356.name: Hunter Dojo: Bubble-jitsu
11356.flavor: So, you would master the way of the hunter? Let's journey on the path to hunterdom together! A true hunter has total mastery of their techniques, making each hunt a bewitching dance. Go and study under Mizutsune-sensei to learn how to move with grace!

11357.name: "Kiken" Means "Danger"!
11357.flavor: I see it! Up above ship! Biiiig kage! Kage means "shadow"! In all the blue sky, a Rathalos flying. Not rumor! I see it with own eyes! It appear in single minute, DOKAAAAN! That why you must hunt! I relying on you!

11358.name: Hunter Dojo: Lightning Wushu
11358.flavor: Hey, bro! Another acolyte on the road to hunterlightenment? I dig it. A hunter's gotta be aggressive, know what I'm sayin'? Strike like lightning, instill fear like thunder, all that jazz. You wanna learn how to do that? Go talk to Astalos-sensei. By which I mean "hunt".

11359.name: Heavenly Fire, Earthly Flame
11359.goal: Hunt a Lavasioth and a Rathalos
11359.flavor: What's happening!? First a monster comes flying out of the volcano and then another monster comes bursting out from the earth! Where can I hide!? And I'm all out of Cool Drinks! I'm at the end of my rope here!

11360.name: Frontier Fisticuffs
11360.flavor: I feel like the local monsters are mocking our efforts to settle this land! A couple more of them have appeared to do their worst, but we're not giving up! This is our land and they can't have it! We'll build our settlement over their dead bodies!

11361.name: Down With This Sort of Thing
11361.flavor: What on earth is going on!? Monsters are just going about willy-nilly making the worst racket on MY Ancestral Steppe! This kind of noise pollution has to stop! Somebody contact the Guild and get this mess fixed!

11363.name: Searing Sands
11363.flavor: Wind's getting hot... Big storm's coming, like we've not seen for years. Round about now a whole bunch of monsters'll gather together. If you like a challenge I can tell you where to find them. Of course, if you end up biting the hot gritty dust that's your own concern.

11365.name: Arena Bakalaka-Battle! Woo!
11365.flavor: Happy day-day! Hunter now eligibbible for become minion. But minion of Cha-Cha or Kayamba? Final-final test at hand. In Quest, think-alink of all your true-true leader did for you and make decision. Shaka-laka!

11366.name: Material Old Girl
11366.flavor: Young'uns need to know the fun of getting materials from monsters to upgrade their armor! You look like you know your way around different armors, so I'm going to ask you to take down a Hyper Basarios and a Hyper Shogun Ceanataur in the Volcano!

11367.name: Let the Games Begin
11367.goal: Hunt a Kecha Wacha and a Nerscylla
11367.flavor: Ladies, gentlemen, Lynians and Temnocerans! Welcome to this special surprise show of mine! We've got a Kecha Wacha full of beans and a Nerscylla that's even more aggressive than usual, and they're both gonna make a beeline for you! Good luck!

11401.name: Sky Render
11401.goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
11401.flavor: Well, darling, this one will be hairy with a capital H. Your target? It tears through the sky, leaving red trails, and all who see it relay tales of woe and misfortune. In short, it's a Valstrax. Don't let your guard down for a second.

11402.name: Lavaclad Beast
11402.flavor: Agnaktor surround themselves in lava that cools and hardens to form a protective armor, right? I was wondering why I couldn't use that principle for my own armor... Could you take one on while I watch and make notes? From a safe distance...

11403.name: Battle of 1001 Blades
11403.flavor: Heh heh heh... Did you know the scales of a Seregios are as sharp as any blade? I wonder what'd it be like to cut something with one of those babies... How'd you like to hunt a Seregios and test out those scales for yourself? Heh heh heh...

11404.name: Misty Opportunity?
11404.flavor: There's a lovely little spot in the Misty Peaks that's nice and warm, purrfect for a catnap! Or it would be, except there's a dumb Duramboros making everything cold and shady with its massive bulk! You gotta save my catnap before it's too late!

11405.name: Tracing the Family Tree
11405.flavor: *cough* I'm trying to trace the evolution of *cough* flying wyverns by examining the primitive *sniff* skeletal structure of the Tigrex. Would you hunt one for me? After all, it's not like-- *splutter* not like I could-- *hack* *wheeze* It's not like I-- *haaark*...

11406.name: Beware Twin Horns on the Sand
11406.flavor: I've got a good test for you, darling. A Diablos is lurking around the Desert, blocking us off from some precious resources, so it needs to be removed. If you're who I know you are, you'll be able to take care of this with style. Make it one to get my heart fluttering!

11407.name: Slam Gunk
11407.flavor: You know about the Brachydios that live in the Volcanic Hollow? Course you don't. I'll keep it simple: they can somehow activate the slime, which makes it explode. I need to know how they do this, and you're going to catch one for me. Think you can manage?

11408.name: Ends of the Earth
11408.flavor: I saw it! A monster with golden scales making its way to the Sanctuary! I'm getting all kinds of premonitions... I wish I could say it was nothing, just the ramblings of an old man, but I fear destruction will follow, just like in the legends... We have to do something.

11409.name: Paint It Gold
11409.flavor: I simply adore things that are decked out in glittering gold. I've heard stories about the Rajang's golden hair. I would love to acquire some for my collection, so would you hunt the beast at the Ancestral Steppe for me, perhaps?

11410.name: Everything in Moderation
11410.flavor: Dearie me! What a to-do! A Deviljho in the Marshlands! It'll gobble up all the lovely Aptonoth if we're not careful! Then there'll be none left for me to eat! I will not stand for such a thing, you hear? Please take care of that Deviljho and save my Aptonoth!

11411.name: Heaven and Hell
11411.flavor: I've seen many a monster in my time, but I've never seen such a disgusting one before. Seems like a bad omen if you ask me... Hey, young 'un, why not take care of that beast? You know, before something bad goes down...

11412.name: Blizzard Blower
11412.goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
11412.sub_goal: Wound Kushala Daora's head and wings
11412.flavor: Forecasts says it should be clear, yet the blizzard goes on and on. I suspect that the appearance of that Kushala Daora is responsible for the sudden changes in weather. It'd be quite a challenge for us to get rid of it... Do you think you could look into it?

11413.name: Steel Yourself
11413.goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
11413.sub_goal: Wound K.Daora's head and sever its tail
11413.flavor: Hey, have you heard anything about this steel dragon doohickey in the Jungle? I need it. I need to make a sword out of a dragon. I've never needed anything more in my life. I also need you to take care of it while I pick up the materials, okay?

11414.name: Out of Thin Air
11414.goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
11414.flavor: While out on a mission, I got that feeling I was being followed. I spun round but there was nothing there. Spooked me for sure, but just as I was thinking it was all my imagination, the beast suddenly revealed itself! No time to explain further, just get out there and slay it!

11415.name: Into Thin Air
11415.goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
11415.sub_goal: Break Chameleos's horn and sever its tail
11415.flavor: The other day, I came across one of those Elder Dragons you hear about in the stories. Thought I was about to bite it, but then it just vanished! Hey! Don't give me that look! I know what I saw! Vanished right into nothin'! I hope you, or someone else, can take care of it...

11416.name: Explosion Marks the Spot
11416.goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
11416.flavor: I came here looking for lost treasure at the Volcano, but unfortunately it seems to be well guarded! The treasure's just out of reach, and unless we can avoid the beast's explosions, we'll never lay hands on it. So...fancy helping me fulfill my dream of riches?

11417.name: Sandblasting
11417.goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
11417.sub_goal: Wound Teostra's head and sever its tail
11417.flavor: Big explosions have been spotted sending huge plumes of sand into the air. Might be the work of a Teostra. It'll be a dangerous mission, but if we want to keep nearby villages safe, we'll need a skilled hunter like you to help. We pray you're up to the challenge!

11418.name: Silver-Tongued Storyteller
11418.sub_goal: Wound Silver Rathalos's wings and back
11418.flavor: I used to love my granny's tales of the Silver Rathalos...but I never imagined it actually existed. The stories usually ended up with a nearby village being attacked, so best not to ignore this one... A skilled hunter, such as yourself, could take care of it.

11419.name: Gold Digger
11419.sub_goal: Wound Gold Rathian's wings and back
11419.flavor: Listen! There's been a Gold Rathian! You know, the one with the golden scales! Made of gold! Sweet, precious gold! Wow! I smell an opportunity to make some serious dough! I hear you can handle yourself. Fancy taking her on for me?

11420.name: The Jungle VIP
11420.flavor: I was in the Jungle pursuing a monster, but this crazy golden furball came leaping out at me. It wasn't like your usual Rajang, either. It was furious, attacking anything that moved! You gotta get rid of it for me, please! I'm gonna get flashbacks...

11421.name: Deranged Desert Deviljho
11421.flavor: I can't believe this. We've clearly claimed this land and now some Deviljho's shown up to attack us and our little town. I'm not gonna let it eat all our hard work! Now the odds might be bad, but as long as we look to the future we'll be fine! Who's with me!?

11422.name: Brachydios Brute Squad
11422.flavor: We were visiting Ingle Isle when we were attacked by some creepy monster covered in slime, which slapped its creepy slime-arms in a flash of light and sent us all flying! This isn't how you treat a defense squad! Go on, teach it some manners!

11423.name: Trial by Akantor
11423.flavor: The Hunter's Guild has massed its forces and managed to corner an Akantor. All that remains is to hunt it down now. Of course, this is a highly dangerous task, so we're looking for experienced hunters to take the job. Think you've got what it takes?

11424.name: Polar Peril
11424.flavor: I have another confidential job for you. It's rather private, but important. I'd appreciate your discretion. The job entails you putting down a certain Ukanlos in the Polar Field. It's a dangerous one for sure, so if you want we can discuss worst-case scenarios?

11425.name: Who Will Hunt the Rain?
11425.flavor: I can't remember the last day it didn't rain. We're all out of dry firewood, and even if we had any, the wind would just blow out our fires. Please, I can't stand this storm anymore! Help us, before we all catch pneumonia!

11431.name: A Bone to Pick
11431.flavor: My whole village vanished in a single night. All my friends who lived by the sea, even their newborn child, all gone. For some reason I was spared, and since then I have cherished one hope, and one hope only: that someone'll turn that bag of bones into literal bones.

11432.name: Castle on the Run
11432.flavor: Ahtal-Ka, you know, the monster that's rumored to be a moving fortress? Well, it seems to have vanished somewhere round the Forlorn Citadel. Can something so big just disappear like that? Now's our chance to find out. Set course for battle!

11433.name: Setting the Barioth High
11433.flavor: I rode out to the Frozen Seaway to challenge a white knight who is said to dwell there, but instead I found myself faced with an odd black-glowing knight in place of the white. I thought to challenge him regardless but, alas, was bested. Go in my place, I beg you!

11434.name: Neopteronophobia
11434.sub_goal: Wound S.Queen's head and sever her tail
11434.flavor: My master is an awesome hunter...most of the time. He let slip that he can't stand how Seltas Queens crunch up Seltas. It would be super embarrassing to be the apprentice of an insectophobe, so could you get rid of the bugs so he can stop shuddering?

11435.name: Let's Get Igneous
11435.flavor: The Volcano really does have the most striking rock formations! There's one in particular I would love to get my hands on, but it has to be toasted by a Hyper Rathalos and left to simmer in magma to get the full effect. Does that strike you as doable?

11436.name: Seeking the Sea King
11436.sub_goal: Wound Lagiacrus's chest and sever its tail
11436.flavor: Hey there, kid! Remember when I gave you those weapon blueprints? Well, it just so happens I remembered another one of 'em, and I think you'd like it! Go hunt me down a Hyper Lagiacrus in the Jungle and I'll slap some of my smithly wisdom on ya!

11438.name: Marshland Fandango
11438.flavor: Now there's a Gravios on my tail! Why does this keep happening to me!? Why am I not in the lab looking at it under a microscope!? I'm no hunter. I could take on all the Mosswine you want, but this? Nu-uh. YOU do the hunting, Hunter!

11439.name: It Takes Mizutsune to Tango
11439.sub_goal: Wound Mizutsune's head and sever its tail
11439.flavor: I must have more pupils! Through me, the ancient dance of our ancestors lives on: the dance of the Hyper Mizutsune! Is it not dazzling enough? I'll simply have to go and refresh my skills from the source. I can use the experience to solicit more followers!

11440.name: If These Rocks Could Talk
11440.flavor: Very clever of that hunted Hyper Astalos to slip away in the Jungle like that. Very clever indeed. But not clever enough! I've located an outcrop where the rocks have been deformed by high electrical currents. Shall we go and pay our friend a visit?

11441.name: The Big Push
11441.flavor: We undergo rigorous training day and night to protect our people. So why can't we beat this one lumbering Gammoth!? We hate to admit it, but you're the best for dealing with Hyper monsters like this guy. Go take him down and keep our land safe!

11442.name: All Creatures Cleaved and Small
11442.sub_goal: Wound Glavenus's back and sever its tail
11442.flavor: To learn the art of quick-draw, one's mind must be still as water. And yet, the Glavenus is seen to cut its prey skillfully yet in a profound rage. I begin to question my principles. Can you show me the beast's combat techniques to deepen my understanding?

11443.name: Agnaktor's Deep
11443.flavor: I was really getting very invested in my research at the Volcanic Hollow. If only that Hyper Agnaktor hadn't shown up and ruined everything! It even made me drop a rare Wycademy book on archaeology! I can get it back, I think, but I'd need your help.

11444.name: Something Wicked
11444.sub_goal: Wound G. Magala's wingarms and wings
11444.flavor: What is with that disgusting freak of a monster!? They already look bad to begin with, but this one had a big, creepy aura around it! That thing needs to be hunted before someone gets seriously injured! Well don't just stand there -- GO!

11445.name: Seregios Exposé
11445.flavor: A Seregios, presumed Hyper, has been sighted in the Dunes. Any and all hunters capable of tackling the creature are being scouted as we speak. This has been your average bystander chugging Cool Drinks, reporting live from the scene.

11446.name: Appeal from Authority
11446.flavor: Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the chiefs in this region: Please hunt the Hyper Duramboros currently rampaging through our villages. (Ugh, the stress. Once I've rebuilt my house and bought a new bed, I'm going to nap for a week.)

11447.name: Tigrex Trap
11447.sub_goal: Wound Tigrex's head and sever its tail
11447.flavor: Some criminal with a grudge against the Guild managed to lure some hunters out to the mountain with a false SOS call. Now they're being menaced by a Hyper Tigrex! The criminal was re-apprehended, but the Tigrex is still at large and causing mayhem!

11448.name: Backwater Battle
11448.flavor: A Diablos with a strange, dark aura has been seen wandering this desolate place. But we're not going to let a little thing like that deter us. We didn't come here just to turn tail and run at the sight of a terrifying rampaging monster! If it thinks it can scare us away, it's wrong!

11449.name: Even Brachydios Need A Holiday
11449.sub_goal: Wound Brachydios's head and sever its tail
11449.flavor: A Brachydios has started loiterin' around the Deserted Island. It's makin' it very difficult for people to use the seaways, not to mention makin' us Moga people mighty nervous. Why does it even want to be there? There's nothing to do!

11450.name: Path of the Hunter
11450.flavor: You are approaching true huntlightenment. But there is still a ways to go yet, Hunter! You already have the strength you need -- you just need to learn to wield it to your maximum potential. Find your center, and everything will flow from there!

11454.name: Fade to Black
11454.goal: Slay a Fatalis or repel it
11454.flavor: The black dragon of legend is no longer just a legend. Make use of what you find within the ancient castle and you might stand a chance. The fate of our nation lies in your hands!

11455.name: Glory Glory Alatreon
11455.flavor: Disasters befall us, lives are lost. In the wake of the dragon, only death remains. Its coming means ruin. Repent, people! Repent of your sins! Unless some brave hunter wants to come and slay this thing for us?

11456.name: The End Is Nigh
11456.goal: Slay a Fatalis or repel it
11456.flavor: It's come! The time has come! Not to mention the dragon! Its scales are steeped in blood! It leaves hellfire in its wake! Hunter, if you think you can stop it, then now is the time to give it a whirl!

11457.name: Old Fatalis
11457.goal: Slay a Fatalis or repel it
11457.flavor: Hohoho, the time is ripe! The hour is come! Now the party begins and we must all dance, dance, dance! Put on your best armor, pick up your best weapon and greet your partner! Don't forget to bow! Ahahahaha!

11458.name: Supersonic
11458.goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
11458.flavor: You know what? My ship's a ton faster than that piece of junk over there. But we ended up gettin' chased by some superfast monster, and the shockwave it left behind dropped us right outta the air. Nobody hurts my ship like that, nobody! Can someone take him out?

11459.name: Hunter Dojo: Valstrax-ryu
11459.goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
11459.flavor: You're looking pretty huntlightened, we must say. Feel like training? One of a hunter's most important weapons is resourcefulness, a quick wit, like the ability to read Valstrax's attacks in its wingtips. Think you've got it? Go see Valstrax-sensei and see what happens!

11460.name: Scales of Justice
11460.goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
11460.flavor: So I was on my way to hunt up a shipment of Popo fur when a Valstrax passed by me. I hovered around for a bit just to see if it hadn't dropped a shiny, shiny scale...when it spotted me. I don't need to explain what happened next, do I? Just avenge me, please!

11461.name: Deviljho Hunt
11461.flavor: Yeah, I used to be a hunter. I loved the job, too. But then one day this massive beast came out of nowhere... Almost did me in. I quit the biz. I couldn't hack it. But you -- I bet you could take that monster on...

11462.name: Price Freeze
11462.flavor: Navigating the Frozen Seaway isn't this sailor's idea of fun, but I could have done without the Tigrex playing hide and seek around the place. You need to put a stop to it before my prices freeze for good!

11463.name: Seregios Scuffle
11463.flavor: I really didn't deserve any of this. I was just observing some volcanic activity here, when a Seregios showed up and started whaling on me. Like, dude, if the Volcano blows it'll take you with it! We're on the same side here! Not any more, though. Wanna hunt it for me?

11464.name: Diabolical Delight
11464.flavor: Bwahahaha, I can't believe it! I heard stories long ago about the terrifying Diablos, and now I'm actually in one! Can't tell you how happy that makes me! So, are you gonna be the one to carve your name into history and capture one of these bad boys?

11465.name: Emergency at the Arctic Ridge!
11465.flavor: Urgent. Signs of Rajang detected in Arctic Ridge. Civilian travel routes in danger. People stranded on mountain also at risk. Proceed immediately to Arctic Ridge with all haste.

11466.name: Brachydios Bypass
11466.flavor: This Brachydios came out of nowhere so me and my friend had to hide in a cave. I was hurt so my friend acted as a decoy so I could get away...but he hasn't returned! I'm gonna go to the Volcano to find him. Can you cover me by hunting the Brachydios?

11467.name: A Very Long Engravement
11467.goal: Hunt a Glavenus and a Gravios
11467.flavor: An airship's gone missing in the Volcano region...and my fiancée was on board. I know lots of Glavenus and Gravios live in the region... I know it looks grim, but I can't give up. Can you hunt the monsters while I lead the search party?

11468.name: A Titanic Clash
11468.goal: Hunt an Agnaktor and a Duramboros
11468.flavor: Uh... I may have, uh, done a bad thing. I let an Agnaktor and a Duramboros into the Arena at the same time, and the two of them just went crazy! It's like hell on earth in there! Please, somebody do something before more damage is done!

11469.name: The Ol' Razzle Dazzle
11469.goal: Hunt a Deviljho and a Rajang
11469.flavor: You ready? You must be ready. Both monsters are waiting for you in what I can only assume is eager anticipation! I want you to give those beasties all you've got. Give me a fantastic show!

11470.name: Quest of Friendship
11470.flavor: Feh heh heh, if this Quest doesn't make us best buds I don't know what will! Time to show the other Guildmasters what you're made of with the mother of all Quests! The harder the Quest the deeper the bond, I always say!

11471.name: Fiery Four-way Fracas
11471.flavor: Hahahah! As soon as I heard how well my apprentice was doing, I knew I had to make some new armor to celebrate! Guess who gets to go to the Volcano and hunt every big sucker they can find in the search for materials? YOU! I'll keep the forge hot for you.

11472.name: Pitched Pinnacle Battle
11472.sub_goal: Wound Deviljho's head, sever its tail
11472.flavor: We're up at the Ruined Pinnacle on a survey but a Deviljho took us by surprise. It had some kind of dark aura and powerful attacks which are giving us some trouble. If there's a skilled hunter who can help us out of this, that would be great.

11473.name: A Tragedy in Silver and Gold
11473.goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
11473.flavor: My husband protected me from those fiends, those monsters! But they were Hyper monsters, and he was just one man... He never stood a chance. I've spent all my life searching for them, and I've tracked them to the Ruined Pinnacle. Please, put an end to this pain.

11474.name: Rajang Against The Machine
11474.flavor: Long ago I banished a man who turned out to be innocent, and he swore revenge. Now I fear that time has come, as he's leading a Hyper Rajang to my city! I'm eager to make amends with him and atone for my mistake, but you must defend the city!

11475.name: What's Mine is Mine
11475.flavor: You know how long it took us to find some high-quality ore? Long enough for an Uragaan to shuffle up next to us and then start rolling around wrecking the place! Get its Hyper behind outta here before the entire mine caves in!

11476.name: A Jurassic Frontier Just for You
11476.sub_goal: Wound G.Rathian's head and sever its tail
11476.flavor: My acquaintance says that hunters' weapon arms tremble uncontrollably when up against a powerful enemy. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. So how about you take a quick sojourn to the Jurassic Frontier and show me?

11477.name: By the Light of the Silvery Rath
11477.sub_goal: Wound S.Rathalos's head and sever its tail
11477.flavor: I gaze here up at the moon in the Misty Peaks, and oh, how beautiful it looks! But wait...how strange. It shines silver, but it's no moon...and it's not particularly beautiful either. Or round! 'Tis an evil glow! Please, Hunter, make it leave!

11478.name: Zinogre-enthusiasm
11478.flavor: Looks like some Moga villagers got attacked by a Hyper Zinogre on their way to Yukumo. And I'm the one who invited them to begin with... Ugh, it's all my fault! I hate to be asking you, but could you go out to the Deserted Island and get them to safety?

11479.name: Arctic Ridge Allegiances
11479.flavor: The Guildmasters have been vying to see who gets the most attention from you lately. I don't really care for such nonsense, myself, so I'll just ask you to clean out the Hyper Monsters at the Arctic Ridge. Be careful -- they're all exceptionally strong!

11480.name: Arena Allegiances
11480.flavor: I hear the Val Habar Master has been proactive of late in trying to monopolize your talent. Well, I'm not going to sit idly by and let him have his way! I've prepared a Quest for you. Let your success demonstrate to whom you really owe your loyalty!

11481.name: The Sun and the Moon
11481.goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
11481.flavor: The sun and the moon are opposing entities, destined never to meet. But suppose they do? Why, it would spell the end of the world! And now the Silver Rathalos and Gold Rathian at the Ruined Pinnacle have come to bring ruin upon us all! Gods have mercy!

11482.name: Primal Screams
11482.flavor: We've just had word from the Primal Forest. It seems one of our expedition teams was attacked by an irregular type of Gore Magala. We'll need you to hunt it while we evacuate the team. It won't be easy, I know, but you're the only one we can turn to, Hunter!

11483.name: Garuga's Comeuppance
11483.sub_goal: Wound Yian Garuga's head and wingtalon
11483.flavor: Some jackanapes'd trashed up my veggies, an' I was of a mind to give 'em a real earful. 'Course, that was 'til I heard some overgrown birdfowl gone Hyper was what done the deed! Don't look like he's in the mood for a talkin'. Maybe see if a hunt'll do him good!

11484.name: Jurassic Skulduggery
11484.flavor: Our sources inform us that a close relative of the king has been abducted by a faction seeking to overthrow His Highness. They left by way of the Jurassic Frontier, which is now brimming with large monsters. Assist our rescue party, Hunter, we beseech you!

11485.name: Verdant Hills Missive
11485.flavor: I've had ENOUGH! I've already had it up to here dodging Yian Garuga beaks and Najarala tails. Now there's a Rathian and an Astalos!? This is my last chance. Entrusted this note to a friendly Mosswine. Go on without me, my Mosswine friend. Run free! Find help!

11486.name: R.I.P.
11486.goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
11486.flavor: We were finally ready to sign a peace treaty with the neighboring military powers, but just as we were putting pen to paper, along comes a pair of Hyper wyverns! They're no symbols of peace! Get them out of here, pronto!

11487.name: Death at My Greaves
11487.goal: Hunt a Gravios and a Nerscylla
11487.flavor: The Primal Forest used to be a safe place...relatively speaking. Now? Nobody comes out of there alive. Save for one girl, who was delirious when we found her. Said she danced toe-to-toe with Death itself. Turns out "Death" is a pair of Hyper monsters!

11488.name: Pinnacle Problems
11488.flavor: We knew what we were getting into when we went to survey the Ruined Pinnacle. We were ready for literally anything...except THOSE! A Hyper Basarios, Zinogre, AND Astalos? It's a sight to behold, let me tell you. Hunter, trounce that terrible trio!

11489.name: A Bed of Sand
11489.flavor: My son never came back from his hunt. He knew what he was getting into...but that doesn't stop me from wanting something to remember him by. It's no small errand, but would you brave a den of Hyper monsters to bring me closure, Hunter?

11490.name: Jungle Funk
11490.flavor: Stay calm! An airship delivering a large consignment of Dung Bombs has crashed, and now the Jungle's covered in sh...*ahem*...shovel-loads of the stuff. Hyper Monsters fleeing the stench are hindering the recovery effort... What to do...?

20001.name: Grudge Match: Malfestio
20001.flavor: You DO know your left from your right, don't you? This Malfestio's got powers that'll make you forget. Watch yourself! Weapons: Great Sword, Sword & Shield, Hammer, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun

20002.name: Grudge Match: Khezu
20002.flavor: Okay, Greenhorn. You're up against a Khezu. If its Thunder attacks don't paralyze you, its ugly face will. Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Switch Axe, Lance, Light Bowgun

20003.name: Grudge Match: Najarala
20003.flavor: Ten-hut! Greenhorn, you are about to face the fierce and highly skilled Najarala. Go teach it the meaning of pain! Weapons: Sword & Shield, Insect Glaive, Switch Axe, Charge Blade, Bow

20004.name: Grudge Match: Rathalos
20004.flavor: This time, you're up against a Rathalos. These flyin' pukes'll put you in a world of hurt with their fire and poison. Watch it! Weapons: Sword & Shield, Dual Blades, Hammer, Lance, Heavy Bowgun

20005.name: Grudge Match: Kecha Wacha
20005.flavor: Do your ears hang low? A Kecha Wacha's do, AND can cover its face for extra head protection! Watch out for it, Greenhorn! Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Insect Glaive, Heavy Bowgun

20006.name: Grudge Match: Plesioth
20006.flavor: Bring honor to our beloved Arena by downin' this Plesioth or I'll have you doin' PT until you're old and gray! Weapons: Great Sword, Sword & Shield, Hunting Horn, Gunlance, Light Bowgun

20007.name: Grudge Match: Brachydios
20007.flavor: Think you can bash the Brach, Greenhorn? Time to find out! Keep an eye on its slime: If it turns red... KABOOM! Weapons: Great Sword, Hammer, Charge Blade, Gunlance, Bow

20008.name: Grudge Match: Barioth
20008.flavor: Attention all brave hunters! A Barioth awaits your challenge! The shortest completion times hinge on breaking certain parts of its body... Oops! We're giving hints away, folks! Weapons: Long Sword, Insect Glaive, Charge Blade, Lance, Light Bowgun

20009.name: Grudge Match: Yian Garuga
20009.flavor: Hear ye, hunters! Who among you would slay the fearsome Yian Garuga? You won't have a moment's respite under its constant onslaught! Still interested? Then step up to the plate! Weapons: Dual Blades, Hammer, Insect Glaive, Switch Axe, Bow

20010.name: Grudge Match: Uragaan
20010.flavor: Your foe today, hunters, is the mighty Uragaan! It may not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but who needs brains when you've got an armored shell? Good luck finding the chinks in that! Weapons: Great Sword, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun

20011.name: Grudge Match: Seregios
20011.flavor: Do you strive for greatness, hunters? Well, if you're taking on a Seregios, you'll want to stock up on items for healing gaping slash wounds. Just hope you have the time to use them! Weapons: Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Charge Blade, Lance, Bow
